in_sanskrit.name: Teerath
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Path to Moksha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Teerath एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Teerath refers to a sacred place or path that leads to Moksha, the ultimate liberation from the cycle of birth and death. It is a place of spiritual significance, often associated with pilgrimages and the pursuit of enlightenment.
